mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, we are looking at 78 degrees with overcast skies near Badger Prairie County Park, a First Quarter moon, and an overnight low of 61 with rain expected, plus you can spot the space station tomorrow morning as it travels from Mount Horeb in the southwest high across the sky toward Fitchburg and Madison.

The City of Verona is moving forward with the Mark Drive reconstruction project between Nine Mound Road and Westlawn Avenue, which involves upgrading water mains, sanitary sewers, and adding new concrete sidewalks to improve our local active transportation network.

There is plenty to do in town today, including the Epic Systems UGM, and later tonight you can test your knowledge at trivia nights happening at both Hop Haus Brewing Company and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In a report from last Friday, Verona police arrested a 44-year-old woman for an O W I after she was discovered unresponsive in her vehicle near North Main Street and Cross Country Road.
You can enjoy today's delicious Caramel Chocolate Pecan flavor at Culver's, which remains open until 10 PM tonight.
